description.p: Vinegar is an open-source, configurable, fast bootstrapper for running Roblox Studio on Linux.
This edition is made exclusively for GNOME 50 and newer on Wayland: Studio is rendered through Wine's native Wayland driver, and follows the GNOME dark style and accent color.

screenshot.caption: Roblox Studio running under Vinegar, displaying the script editor view
